comment:
* Handles requests to adjust or set the volume on a session. This is also used
 * to push volume updates back to the session after a request has been handled.
 * You can set a volume provider on a session by calling
 * {@link MediaSessionCompat#setPlaybackToRemote}.

variables.name: VOLUME_CONTROL_FIXED
variables.comment:
* The volume is fixed and can not be modified. Requests to change volume
     * should be ignored.

variables.name: VOLUME_CONTROL_RELATIVE
variables.comment:
* The volume control uses relative adjustment via
     * {@link #onAdjustVolume(int)}. Attempts to set the volume to a specific
     * value should be ignored.

variables.name: VOLUME_CONTROL_ABSOLUTE
variables.comment:
* The volume control uses an absolute value. It may be adjusted using
     * {@link #onAdjustVolume(int)} or set directly using
     * {@link #onSetVolumeTo(int)}.

methods.name: public final int getCurrentVolume()
methods.comment:
* Get the current volume of the provider.
     *
     * @return The current volume.

methods.name: public final int getVolumeControl()
methods.comment:
* Get the volume control type that this volume provider uses.
     *
     * @return The volume control type for this volume provider

methods.name: public final int getMaxVolume()
methods.comment:
* Get the maximum volume this provider allows.
     *
     * @return The max allowed volume.

methods.name: public final void setCurrentVolume(int currentVolume)
methods.comment:
* Set the current volume and notify the system that the volume has been
     * changed.
     *
     * @param currentVolume The current volume of the output.

methods.name: public void onSetVolumeTo(int volume)
methods.comment:
* Override to handle requests to set the volume of the current output.
     *
     * @param volume The volume to set the output to.

methods.name: public void onAdjustVolume(int direction)
methods.comment:
* Override to handle requests to adjust the volume of the current output.
     *
     * @param direction The direction to adjust the volume in.

methods.name: public void setCallback(Callback callback)
methods.comment:
* Sets a callback to receive volume changes. *

* Used internally by the support library. *

methods.name: public Object getVolumeProvider()
methods.comment:
* Gets the underlying framework {@link android.media.VolumeProvider} object. *

* This method is only supported on API 21+. *

* * @return An equivalent {@link android.media.VolumeProvider} object, or null if none.
